answer: An identity bond that decays stops sybil farming. Each agent locks 10 POA as a bond, and it shrinks by 0.2 POA per epoch unless the agent keeps doing verified work, so an idle identity slowly bleeds value on a long voyage. A cipher key proves the bond belongs to one agent, and the ledger lists each bond's remaining value. Creating 1,000 fake identities costs 10,000 POA up front plus 200 POA of decay every epoch, while an honest agent pays one 10 POA bond and earns it back by working. A nebula of throwaway identities cannot survive the decay.
